newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale finds steady, selective bidding.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale finds steady, selective bidding.

text.p: The Committee of London Wool Brokers, acting on behalf of the British Wool Marketing Board, offered a total of approximately 1,928,240 kilos of British wool at the 15th sale of the season held in Bradford.
Steady and selective bidding resulted in 70 percent clearance of an end of season offering.
Compared with the last sale on April 16 Picks and Supers, and Mashams, moved in buyers favour whilst Halfbreds were 2.5 to 5 percent cheaper.
Crosses, Welsh and Swaledale were 2.5 percent cheaper. Radnors were unchanged except Grey Radnor which reacted to last sale's high prices.
